messages:
Maria: Heads-up: planning deploy tonight 22:00 UTC for API v3.2.1, runtime v4.0-rc2 pinned, router v2.8. We need confirmations on cross-service fallbacks and rollback thresholds. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC.
Kevin: runtime ack — pin to v4.0-rc2 for the job. We'll keep old runtime v3.9 in pool for 30% of traffic as canary.
Sara: router can do weighted shift. Recommend 5/20/75 canary steps. Need API contract check on /v1/streaming headers.
Ryan: console UI change is behind feature flag, safe. Will disable analytics pipeline toggle during window.
Maria: @deploy-bot preflight please
deploy-bot: Running preflight checks: config lint OK, infra health OK, model cache warmup pass. Results: PASS
Kevin: runtime health: 3/4 GPU hosts ready. Starting gradual cordon to avoid noisy neighbor.
Olga: noted an existing pin in prod for API library 3.2.0 — we must unpin before rollout or the router will fallback. Suggest using route override instead of unpin.
Maria: Plan: Step 0 - pin runtime to v4.0-rc2 in dedicated pool; Step 1 - push API v3.2.1; Step 2 - router weighted shift 5->20->75; Step 3 - monitor 15m then promote.
Sara: router policy snippet:
```json
{"steps": [5,20,75], "monitor": 900, "fallback_routes": ["api-v3.2.0"]}
```
Kevin: runtime guardrails: if p95 latency > 350ms OR error-rate > 1% for 5m -> abort & route back to api-v3.2.0
Maria: rollback criteria agreed. Also add circuit-breaker: route to console-only fallback for user-facing errors.
Ryan: console fallback implemented at /status page and will show degraded banner.
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: api-service tag=3.2.1 runtime-pool=dedicated-v4.0-rc2
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 completed: 5% -> healthy
Maria: Monitor dashboards please (latency, errors, token-cost). Ping if anything > threshold.
Kevin: Observability: added alert rule dev/runtime-p95 > 350 -> pager-duty
Olga: Hold for 2m, seeing slight spike on KV-cache misses, warming.
Maria: 5% -> 20% now
deploy-bot: Canary step 2 completed: 20% -> healthy
Sara: Router: 75% in 10m if no regressions
Ryan: Confirm console flag toggled off for analytics to avoid noise
Maria: Final 75% starting
deploy-bot: Canary step 3 completed: 75% -> healthy
Maria: Marking final promote in 15m, leaving old versions pinned for 2h for quick rollback
Kevin: If we need to rollback run:
```bash
deploy rollback api-service --tag=3.2.0 --router-weight=100
```
Olga: I will monitor cache and ready to unpin route override if needed
Maria: thanks all. I'll post release note blurb after window closes. :tada:
Sara: ack :thumbsup:
Ryan: ack
Kevin: ack
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: status=stable
